diagnostics.message: The `google_network_connectivity_spoke` `spoke-ra` (router-appliance spoke) only becomes functional/ACTIVE after the Cloud Router's BGP session with the first router appliance is configured by `google_compute_router_peer.peer_0`. The spoke references the appliance VMs only through `var.router_appliances`, so it has no dependency on `peer_0` and Terraform may create the spoke before the BGP peering exists. Order the spoke after `google_compute_router_peer.peer_0` (e.g. via `depends_on`).

The `google_network_connectivity_spoke` `spoke-ra` (router-appliance spoke) only becomes functional/ACTIVE after the Cloud Router's BGP session with the second (redundant) router appliance is configured by `google_compute_router_peer.peer_1`. Because the spoke gets the appliance VMs only from `var.router_appliances`, it has no dependency on `peer_1` and Terraform may create the spoke before that BGP peering exists. Order the spoke after `google_compute_router_peer.peer_1` (e.g. via `depends_on`).
